$comment: Single source for the install and port facts. Consumers: the docs-site components in docs-site/src/components/platforms.tsx (<Install platform=…/>, <Installer/>, <Ports/>), which read the byte-identical snapshot docs-site/src/data/platforms.json, and crates/install/lilynk-setup, which embeds this file for its install lines and floors. A port number, repo URL or install command lives here and nowhere else; pages quote it and do not restate it. `install` is the shell snippet that puts the host on the box, one line per entry, in order. `floor` is the one-line minimum system for that platform, as a person reads it. scripts/ci/check-docs-drift.sh checks that this file parses and that the snapshot matches it.

mgmt.what: management REST API (HTTPS + token; read-only status/library off loopback)
mgmt.conflict: Sunshine / Apollo / Vibeshine serve their web UI on 47990 too — the one port still shared with them once GameStream compat is off. Move it via LILYNK_MGMT_BIND; clients relearn it from discovery.

web.what: web console (HTTPS, login-gated); plugin interfaces on 47993

browser.what: browser streaming (preview, off until switched on)

gamestream.conflict: Sunshine / Apollo / Vibeshine bind these same fixed ports and advertise the same mDNS name — run only one GameStream host at a time, or keep lilynk native-only.

firewall.$comment: Service/profile names the Linux packages install for firewalld and ufw — the packages never open a port themselves.

installer.$comment: The guided Linux installer (preview). No download of it is published: fromSource builds lilynk-setup in a clone and runs the scripts/install.sh stub on it, as the stub's --help says. The docs hub quotes these lines.

conflicts.detectExit: 1 only when a conflicting host runs or will start on its own; dormant leftovers print but exit 0

platforms.name: Debian 13+ / Ubuntu 26.04+
platforms.floor: Debian 13 or newer; Ubuntu 26.04 or newer
install: sudo apt install lilynk-host lilynk-web lilynk-scripting

platforms.$comment: Omarchy IS Arch for delivery — same signed repo, same packages — but NOT the same install command. Omarchy ships a libalpm PreTransaction hook (00-omarchy-update-guard) that ABORTS any transaction whose pacman invocation carries both -S and -u, so Arch's `pacman -Syu <pkgs>` dies with 'Woah partner...' and installs nothing (measured on 4.0.1, 2026-08-28). `-Sy` refreshes without a sysupgrade and is not blocked, and `-S` then installs. Everything Omarchy-specific is the setup line after them.
platforms.name: Omarchy
install: sudo pacman -S lilynk-host lilynk-web lilynk-scripting lilynk-client

platforms.name: Fedora 43+
install: # fedora-44 on Fedora 44; bazzite on Fedora 43 (a plain Fedora 43 build of the same package)
sudo dnf install lilynk lilynk-web lilynk-scripting

platforms.name: Bazzite / Fedora Atomic
platforms.floor: Current Bazzite; Fedora Atomic 43 or newer

platforms.name: Linux client (any distro)
platforms.floor: Any distro with Flatpak; native packages on Ubuntu 26.04, Fedora 43 and Arch, or newer

platforms.name: Windows client
platforms.floor: Windows 10 or newer, x64 and Arm64

platforms.name: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV
platforms.floor: iOS, iPadOS and tvOS 17 or newer
